slides.headline: Born on September 5th: the philosopher who became a president, then gave his birthday away.
Dr. Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan
slides.body: Born in Tiruttani, Tamil Nadu, in 1888. A philosopher and scholar who became India's Vice President in 1952, then its second President from 1962 to 1967. Awarded the Bharat Ratna in 1954.

slides.headline: In 1962, his students wanted to celebrate his birthday. He redirected it.
slides.body: When friends and students asked to mark his birthday as President, Radhakrishnan asked instead that the day be dedicated to every teacher in the country. That request became Teachers' Day — observed every September 5th since.

slides.eyebrow: Why it matters for Viksit Bharat 2047
slides.headline: He turned personal recognition into a system that outlasted him.
slides.body: Every teacher shaping the workforce behind India's next 20 years traces back to that one instinct — build something bigger than yourself. That's the same bet Viksit Bharat 2047 is making, at national scale.
